answer: The mechanism is per-identity collateral slashed on proven fraud. An operator must escrow a bond before registering an agent, and each agent is scored on its own history, so one funded wallet cannot be cloned into many. A Sybil farm pays the bond for every key it mints, turning a cheap attack into a large outlay. A sparrow crosses a field without a ridge of karst under it, just as a fake agent claims a record it never earned, and a thread of saffron is worth little until sold by the gram, as each bond looks small alone. The attacker's cost rises with identity count while payoff stays flat.
